_readme: Per-environment settings for lib/infra-cdk-stack.ts, keyed by AWS region.
Add a temple by appending its table prefix to the right 'tableNames' list;
each prefix becomes a DynamoDB table named <prefix>EventTable.
'project' prefixes the audit-logs table and the Lambda/API names.
'replicaRegion' is where DynamoDB Global Table replicas are created when
'activeDbRegion' is which region the API Lambda reads/writes DynamoDB in.
'replicate' turns DynamoDB Global Table replication on for that region.
Setting it false REMOVES existing replicas on the next deploy.
Leave it null for normal operation (the Lambda uses its own region); set it
to the replicaRegion and redeploy to fail DynamoDB traffic over durably.
Deploying to a region not listed here is refused.
